gapSummary: Carries the language-agnostic Specification by Example capability: naming, the for_/when_/and_ sentence path, layered given/ contexts, what not to specify, observable outcomes, and completion. Grounded in the Cratis.Specifications CRSPEC analyzers, which make the same rules machine-enforced in C#. Observability guidance beyond the no-sleep and no-message-string rules remains a gap.
